rationale.text: Each field has a labelling mechanism the test names: a label with for, aria-label, aria-labelledby pointing to an identified passage, a title attribute; and one field sits inside a label without for, which the glossary's label definition accepts. Each field meets one of the conditions. The check record never answers no_fault: it does not decide whether a present mechanism is sufficient and answers cannot_tell (step 3). The finding is needs_review: not_enabled at fail_only, and alternative_unresolved at full, since the check's link is partial and so not resolving.

citations.quote: Chaque champ de formulaire vérifie-t-il une de ces conditions

Le champ de formulaire possède un attribut WAI-ARIA `aria-label`
Une balise `<label>` ayant un attribut `for` est associée au champ de formulaire
Le champ de formulaire possède un attribut `title`
